review_evidence: Reviewed the 123-file Carleson snapshot and project verification documentation.

The repository contains a completed Lean proof of generalized Carleson theorems, including classical, metric-space, and linearized metric-space Carleson results and their supporting harmonic analysis.
The primary sources are core mathematical definitions and proofs; no lossless exclusion is warranted.
summary: Retain carleson in full as the formalized proof of generalized Carleson theorems and supporting harmonic analysis.

review_evidence: Basics.lean: 44 declarations, including theorem measure_comap_eq_subtype_coe, lemma NoAtoms'.subtype, theorem exists_measurable_between, noncomputable def PFun.ofGraph' and PFun graph lemmas, all with proofs.

Metric.lean: lemma NoAtoms'.of_metric (a proper pseudometric space measure with equal closed and open ball measures has no atoms) with a full tactic proof, plus NoAtoms' instances for Haar-type measures on normed spaces and for volume on unitInterval.

Prod.lean: 29 declarations, including defs essProjFst and essProjSnd (essential projections of subsets of a product) and theorems essProjFst_subset, essProjFst_eq, essProjFst_times_univ, essProjFst_mono with proofs.
summary: Inspected all three NoAtoms files under Carleson/ToMathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure. Each holds proved Lean declarations about atomless measures (subtype restriction, measurable sets between given sets, partial functions from graphs, metric criteria, product-space essential projections). All stay searchable; no exclusions.
